        "\n",
        "for col in ['client_type','gender','country','region','acquisition_purpose','referral_channel']:\n",
        "    df[col] = df[col].fillna(df[col].mode()[0])\n",
        "\n",
        "df['satisfaction_score'] = df['satisfaction_score'].fillna(df['satisfaction_score'].median())\n",
        "df['loan_applied'] = df['loan_applied'].fillna('No')"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "aKEilnaLlyhL"
      },
      "execution_count": 4,
      "outputs": []
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "df['date_of_birth'] = pd.to_datetime(df['date_of_birth'], errors='coerce')\n",
        "df['Age'] = 2026 - df['date_of_birth'].dt.year\n",
        "df = df.dropna(subset=['Age'])"
      ],
      "metadata": {
        "id": "VKITHLxfl8Rz"
      },
      "execution_count": 5,
      "outputs": []

        "from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler\n",
        "\n",
        "# Check nulls\n",
        "print(df[['Age', 'satisfaction_score']].isnull().sum())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Fill nulls\n",
        "df['Age'] = df['Age'].fillna(df['Age'].median())\n",
        "df['satisfaction_score'] = df['satisfaction_score'].fillna(df['satisfaction_score'].median())\n",
        "\n",
        "# Scaling\n",
        "scaler = StandardScaler()\n",
        "df[['Age_scaled', 'satisfaction_scaled']] = scaler.fit_transform(df[['Age', 'satisfaction_score']])\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Done!\")\n",

        "# See cluster centers\n",
